summary: A departing teacher cries a little, jokes, and hands credit to the people around them.
realLife: Retiring educators said it didn't feel real, took a pie in the face at an assembly, and gave credit to staff, volunteers and parents; they named a few things they would not miss and moved on.
sources: Arkansas Democrat-Gazette, Northwest Arkansas educators say farewell (2016): https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2016/may/30/northwest-arkansas-educators-say-farewe/
inGame: a school record and a job-ended event for a teacher; needs: a farewell assembly scene

turns.summary: The teacher leaves quietly with the key.
turns.writesBack: colleagues feel a gap; a journal note
